author: dvsdigger
body: I was playing and had no warnings or issues then went AFK and when I logged back on I had been banned can some one tell me what I did excessive infractions ? what and when ?
body_tagged: I was playing and had no warnings or issues then went AFK and when I logged back on I had been banned can some one tell me what I did excessive infractions ? what and when ?
title: not appealing just looking for info on why.

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Banning for excessive infractions is not something you actually do in the moment, but something more related to your infraction history. As you can see in https://avicus.net/dvsdigger#infractions you have 28 infractions, and you were already banned for Excessive Infractions before.

Our policy is tempbanning for it at 20 infractions, then if the player continues getting them we permanently ban them. So yeah you do exactly meet those requirements.

To sum it up, "can some one tell me what I did excessive infractions ? what and when ?". You have a really dirty infraction history. What? Not following the rules a lot lot lot of times. When? February 14, 2014 at 12:41 AM EST - Nowadays.

Make sure to read the rules and abide them, and maybe make another appeal in some months, and definitely not getting any other infraction ever.

Regards,
Javipepe - Avicus Network Developer, Moderator and Referee.
